nom: RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30

segments.sensitive: One reviewer with super sensitive under eyes who cannot tolerate eye creams reports no irritation or burning after weeks of use, and another who had contact dermatitis from a competitor's product had none with this one.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or 60+ skin and hereditary bags/wrinkles report the product smooths and brightens without eliminating hereditary puffiness, and one notes fragile, thin skin from aging felt soothed by the metal tip.
segments.dry: One reviewer says the formula feels kind of dry on the eye and creases, while others describe it as hydrating and not drying.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describe reduced appearance of fine lines, crow's feet, and a smoothing/plumping effect around aging skin, with one crediting the Tightenyl ingredient for smoothing fine lines; a mature-skin reviewer says hereditary bags and wrinkles are only somewhat helped, not eliminated.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers call the formula hydrating, moisturizing, and non-drying under the eyes, though one reviewer found it feels dry on her eye and wished for a more dewy, moisturizing finish.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports it helps even out morning redness and coloring around the nose area.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with fragile, thin, aging skin found the metal applicator soothing on delicate skin, and a sensitive-eye user reports zero irritation despite normally reacting to eye products.

extraits.texte: I have super sensitive under eyes to the point where I can't even use eye creams. Almost all eye products make my under eye area puffy and/or make my eyes burn slightly. i was using a concealer that I really liked but it was a little thick. I tried this on a whim and I love it! Not only does it not cause any irritation whatsoever, it may just be the best concealer I have used. It covers beautifully while being practically indetectable. It's been a couple of weeks and still no irritation. I'm so happy to have discovered this!

My dark circles are a challenge for any product. I have an olive complexion with blue dark circles which have always been a problem but they are getting worse with age. I have used a concealer from RMS that I bought many years ago. It is in a tub and is the only one that really worked. This new one is in a tube and is even better because it has a bit of pink in it, so I don't look like a pasted plaster under my eyes. I will keep using it, but I wonder how long the tube will last.

I have probably 10 undereye corrector/concealers. . as none them seemed to work. This works! great on mature skin, brightens, covers the dark. Highly reccomend and I will continue to use this product and toss the others!

Creamy, easily blended- this eye brightener is wonderful! I like to use my blending brush to pull any extra down to my nose area. Softens features and fine lines. Such a pretty peachy shade makes my 60+ yr old skin look radiant too!

It's ok -- color is a bit to peachy, but it blends in fairly well. I do think it creases a bit and feels kind of dry on my eye. Doesn't work better than what I was using. Also the applicator/ball is not practical and isn't a good application or blending tool, IMO.

This works to smooth and protect my under eye area. It layers fantastic over my sunscreen and the radiance locking primer. It also works seamlessly with my rms concealer, because my circles are so dark I need extra help. The correction is nice and therefore I can use less concealer . It never looks cakey, crusty, or dry. It doesn't even crease. The soothing metal ball is perfect for my puffy under eyes, and the caffeine helps to depuff as much as humanly possible. It's ts pricey, but a little goes a long way. I had yried a competitor's product, but it gave me contact dermatitis. RMS did not. Winner winner chicken dinner!
I do not like this, it settles into fine lines and does not have hardly any coverage, I am going to send it back, I really wanted to like it.
